test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting in a row facing north. U is adjacent to S and P. P is second to the left of Q.Q is at an extreme end.

Who is sitting second from the left end?
solution:
**Six Person: **P, Q, R, S, T and U

1) Q is at an extreme end.

(Q can sit at any end point, so there is two case are possible) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c98ee4f8fc02f114e979f6a190a877c2cc7eac01c742dff6442f3b7ecee767f9.png] 

2) P is second to the left of Q.

(Form this statement Q can only sit right end, So Case-1 is eliminated)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63975beeff1fa9bb97c161fda52c4dc6db3c062341b835a7f883a6622c2dc594.png] 

3) U is adjacent to S and P.

(R & T sitting position are not cleared)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b60eb1df42a47b94cf084e2be2fccbf9b2ca375b83516e031922cb10163b66a.png] 

From above seating arrangement **"S" **is seating second form the left end. 

Hence, the correct answer is **'S'****.**
